title: 第124章 青鱼巷口
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

就在前两日,太子跟赵栋将军居然一起喝得酩酊大醉，走到东宫之外大耍酒疯，甚至冲撞了正好要去陛下寝宫的淑妃。

两个醉汉胡言乱语,冲撞了妃子的坐辇还嬉皮笑脸，吓得淑妃花容失色，跑到陛下面前好一顿哭诉。

陛下最爱宠淑妃，听闻这二人无状，气得怒发冲冠，责罚太子长跪宗祠，而赵栋也被一纸调令，调回去北方养兵放羊。

就在陛下和太子关系日趋紧张的时候,宗氏也总算是召见了自己的父亲和弟弟。

宗庆如今新封了侯爷，也是面带得意之色。不过他入宫谒见皇后,除了一叙亲情之外,还是要跟女儿商量些顶要紧的事情。

如今女婿出息,成为国之储君，他也摇身一变,成为国丈。

只是这国丈花期太短，等那韩临风上位的时候，这等荣宠就要换人享受了。

趁着朝野群臣围攻太子私德有亏，陛下和太子也闹不和的时候，他当然得给自己这少根筋的女儿好好筹谋一下，省得白白给别人做了嫁衣。

宗氏起初只是听着父亲挨着自己小声细说。可是越听她的眼睛瞪得越大,最后吓得她猛一推父亲：“你当这是哪里？梁州的乡野王府？怎么敢这般胡言乱语，妄议国事！”

宗庆看着女儿大惊小怪的样子，就觉得到底是妇人，不能成事。

“陛下的嫡子,原本就该是逍儿！若不是你当初心善，有他什么事儿？他一辈子是母亲低贱的庶子，出不了头来！如今听那风头，他是要舍江山就美人，愈加得陛下不喜。既然如此，他下去了，逍儿便是顺位的国储，有名有分！你不趁着这个机会使一使气力，待那个什么淑妃又生出个杂种来争抢太子之位，你连哭都哭不出来！”

宗氏原本就是耳根子发软的人，而父亲的这一番话，也是说得她的心左摇右晃。

而接下来几日，不断有世家臣子的夫人在跟她闲聊时，委婉表明了世家的人心所向——诸位大人都觉得二皇子为人好学谦良，深的诸位大人的欣赏，宗氏彻底动心了。

毕竟韩临风放言为了苏落云，宁可不做太子，可怨不得别人。

他若不做，自然要让给弟弟。就像父亲所言，趁着那些宠妃们还没生出子嗣来，这事儿早早定下来，才不能生变。

她心里如此想的，也叫来了儿子偷偷商议此事。

那韩逍平日里虽然看着孤高自傲，其实也是没有经过什么事情的，被母后这么一说，方寸大乱，一时想到自己将来也许能够坐在龙椅上号令群臣，心里也有些飘飘然。

结果他回寝宫时，心里也是装不住事情，一时得意忘形，跟自己的王妃郑氏闲说了那么一嘴。

结果郑氏越听眼睛瞪得越大，沉默了一会问韩逍：“二皇子您是如何想的？”

韩逍道：“母后说，那些臣子私下拥戴我，也许这几日早朝时，就会有言官请奏，恳请陛下废国储，改立我为太子。我能怎么样？当然是父皇母后怎么说，我便怎么做了！”

郑氏默默看着韩逍满面遮掩不住的喜悦神色，先是屈身道：“那妾身便提前恭贺二皇子高升了……”

说完之后，她转身来到了桌案前，铺好了纸张，研墨蘸笔，开始挥腕写起字来。

韩逍知道自己的这位王妃才是真正的大雅之人，心道：莫不是她要和诗一首，为我助兴？

于是他也是兴奋含笑，眼巴巴地坐等着。

结果，郑氏写好了之后，将那张纸呈递给韩逍时，韩逍定睛一看，鼻子差点没有气歪——那郑氏写的居然是一封和离求去的文书。

“你这是跟我大嫂学的？没事写这个东西作甚？这是什么惊世大作吗！我跟我皇兄还得人手一份？”

韩逍虽然老早就怀疑这女子有大才学，心里是看不上自己的。可是真印证了，堂堂皇子还是气得原地蹦高。

难怪皇兄这几日意志消沉，堂堂皇子，被个女子递送休书，太也他妈的气人了！

郑氏看着气得跳起的二皇子，语气沉沉道：“我当初听祖父言，二皇子心思至纯，为人清高，不屑于专营，我这才放下顾虑，点头应下这门亲事。因为我觉得与您这样的人相守，日子就算平淡些，却也心安。可是现在不过是朝前一些别有用心之人的风言风语，您就如此沉不住气，居然想要僭越兄长，坐着承袭之梦。您的志愿太高远，与小女子的为人志向不同。郑家虽然没有丞相之苗，辅国之才，但几代为人都是潜心学问，远离朝政争斗。道不同不相为谋，小女子自觉不配，就此求去，还望皇子恩准！”

二皇子觉得自己听明白了，瞪大眼睛道：“哦，我明白了，你就是瞧不起我！觉得我不如我大哥才学，不配做这一国储君？”

郑氏虽然平日温婉，为人谦和，可是现在既然话已经说到这个份儿上，她索性也不怕得罪了二皇子：“太子文韬武略样样俱佳，扫平北地十八州，功勋卓著，更是带头推行新政，剪除大魏政务弊习。可就是这般铁腕人物，却遭到朝前群臣如骇浪巨波一般的声讨，试问一声，您又有何功绩威信，坐在那等高处不胜寒的位置上？那些朝臣是当真觉得您有惊世伟才，还是觉得您比太子更好拿捏？你今日一说，我竟没有半点喜色，只觉得您若真顺着那些臣子之意，前方之路血雨腥风，一旦深陷……万劫不复啊！”

说到了最后，郑氏已经哽咽出声，泪水打湿了粉嫩的面颊。

他们新婚燕尔，也正是情意渐浓时。韩逍婚后才慢慢了解自己的这位妻子是何等藏拙之人，她不光精通金石刻章，而且诗词歌舞造诣无不精深。

也难怪郑家祖父看不上他写的酸诗，跟这位真正的才女相比，自己简直如浅薄刚开蒙的稚儿一般。

而现在，郑氏声泪俱下的一番话，也算是震醒犹在美梦里的他。

他现在正跟着皇兄学习处理政事，在朝堂上也聆听过数场老臣们与父皇唇枪舌战。每次看到父皇被老臣气得怒不可遏，却要投鼠忌器，拼命压抑怒火时，他都觉得当皇帝其实怪没意思的。

以前韩逍都是身在父兄之后，悠哉游哉，学着处理文书之后，便可回宫刻刻印章，喂一喂游鱼笼鸟，日子过得好不惬意！

可一旦成了太子，就得像父兄那样，跟一群似狼似狐的老臣们斗智斗勇。

他虽然自认为自己才学斐然，可是那些政务俗事，他也的确是处理不来啊！

想到这，他从母后那里听闻这储君变动的喜悦，顿时消弭了大半。

意乱心慌间，韩逍忍不住问郑氏：“可是皇兄若不愿意当太子，就得是我了，那父皇也没有别的儿子了。他们非要将我架在火塘上烤，那我该如何是好？”

郑氏一看二皇子还算能听得进她的话，语气略缓，站起身来，附在二皇子的耳边，细细说了起来……

这几日，陛下几乎每次见了太子，都有些恨铁不成钢，总是将他痛骂一顿。

加上彦县这几日又有流民闹事，发生土地争抢的械斗，韩临风便亲自带人前往查看情况了。

也算是寻了避开父皇痛骂的借口，避走离京。

韩临风离京之后，这朝堂上的风气就开始变得诡异。

这日又是群臣苦口婆心地劝谏，再次有人拿韩临风的血统出身说嘴，直言跟大皇子相比，其实二皇子这个正宗嫡子，才是适合的人选。

陛下沉默地听着，转头看向了自己的二皇子。

毕竟今日群臣的口径一致，绝非临时起意，像是事先窜好了词一样，就是不知道他这个二儿子是何反应了。

若是没有被郑氏劝解，那么韩逍大抵是会恭谨听着，若是父皇被群臣劝动，那么自己也只能顺水推舟了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Just two days ago, the Crown Prince and General Zhao Dong got extremely drunk together. They walked outside the East Palace and acted like crazy. They even bumped into Concubine Shu who was going to His Majesty's palace.

The two drunkards talked nonsense, bumped into the concubine's chariot and smiled playfully. The concubine Shu was so frightened that she turned pale and ran to his majesty to cry.

His Majesty loves Concubine Shu the most. When he heard that these two people were shameless, he was so angry that he punished the prince for kneeling in the ancestral hall. Zhao Dong was also ordered to go back to the north to raise troops and herd sheep.

Just when the relationship between His Majesty and the Crown Prince became increasingly tense, Zong finally summoned his father and younger brother.

Zong Qing now has a new title of Marquis, and he also looks proud.However, when he went to the palace to see the queen, in addition to talking about family ties, he still had to discuss some most important matters with his daughter.

Now that the son-in-law has prospered and become the crown prince of the country, he has also transformed into the father-in-law of the country.

It's just that the flowering period of the prince is too short. When Han Linfeng comes to power, someone else will enjoy this honor.

Taking advantage of the fact that the officials of the government and the public were besieging the prince for his personal moral deficiencies, and that his majesty and the prince were at odds, of course he had to make a good plan for his young daughter, so as not to make a wedding dress for someone else in vain.

At first, Zong just listened to his father whispering next to him.But the more she listened, the bigger her eyes widened. Finally, she was so frightened that she pushed her father hard: "Where do you think this is? The royal palace in the countryside of Liangzhou? How dare you talk nonsense and discuss state affairs like this!"

Zong Qing looked at his daughter making such a fuss and felt that she was a woman and couldn't do anything.

"His Majesty's legitimate son should have been Xiao'er! If you hadn't been kind-hearted at the beginning, what would have happened to him? He has been a bastard whose mother was humble all his life and could not get ahead! Now that he hears the limelight, he is willing to sacrifice his country for beauty, which will make him even more popular with Your Majesty.Not happy.In this case, if he goes down, Xiao'er will be the crown prince, and he will be famous!If you don't take advantage of this opportunity, you won't even be able to cry when that concubine Shu gives birth to another bastard to compete for the crown prince's position!"

Zong was originally a soft-eared person, and her father's words also made her heart sway.

In the next few days, the wives of ministers from the aristocratic family kept chatting with her, and they tactfully expressed the aristocratic family's people's aspirations - all the adults felt that the second prince was studious and modest, and they deeply appreciated him. Zong was completely moved.

After all, Han Linfeng said that he would rather not be the prince for Su Luoyun's sake, but he could not blame others.

If he doesn't do it, he will naturally give it to his younger brother.Just like what my father said, before those beloved concubines gave birth to children, this matter should be settled early so that nothing could change.

With this in mind, she also called her son to discuss the matter secretly.

Although Han Xiao looked aloof and arrogant on weekdays, he actually had not experienced anything. When his mother said this, he was in a state of confusion. He thought that he might be able to sit on the dragon throne and command the ministers in the future, and he felt a little uneasy.

As a result, when he returned to the palace, he couldn't keep it in mind, and he got carried away for a while and had a casual chat with his princess, Zheng Shi.

As a result, Zheng's eyes widened even more as she listened. She was silent for a while and asked Han Xiao: "Second Prince, what do you think?"

Han Xiao said: "The Queen Mother said that those ministers support me privately. Maybe in the morning in the next few days, there will be officials to report, begging Your Majesty to depose the Crown Prince and make me the Crown Prince instead. What can I do? Of course, I will do whatever my father, the Queen, and the Queen say!"

Mrs. Zheng silently looked at Han Xiao's expression of joy that could not be concealed. She bowed and said, "I would like to congratulate the second prince in advance on his promotion..."

After finishing speaking, she turned around and came to the desk, laid out the paper, dipped her pen in the ink, and began to write with a wave of her wrist.

Han Xiao knew that his princess was a truly elegant person, so he thought to himself: Could it be that she wants to compose a poem to cheer me up?

So he also smiled excitedly and sat waiting eagerly.

As a result, after Zheng had finished writing, she presented the piece of paper to Han Xiao. Han Xiao took a closer look and his nose almost became angry - what Zheng had written was actually a letter to leave with Li Qiu.

"You learned this from my sister-in-law? What are you doing writing this when you have nothing to do? Is this some kind of world-shattering masterpiece? My brother and I have to share a copy?"

Although Han Xiao had long suspected that this woman was talented and learned, he still looked down upon himself.But when it was really confirmed, the dignified prince was still so angry that he jumped up on the spot.

No wonder the emperor's brother has been depressed these days. It's so damn irritating for a majestic prince to be handed a divorce letter by a woman!

Zheng looked at the second prince who jumped up with anger, and said in a deep tone: "I heard from my grandfather that the second prince was pure in heart, noble in character, and disdainful of monopolies, so I put aside my worries and nodded to accept the marriage. Because I feel that with someone like you, life will be dull, but I will feel at ease. But now it is just the rumors of some people with ulterior motives in the past.Feng Yu, you are so restive that you want to overtake your brother and inherit the dream.Your ambition is too lofty and different from the young lady's ambition.Although the Zheng family has no talents to serve as prime minister, they have devoted themselves to learning and stayed away from the political struggle for generations.The young lady feels that she is not worthy, so I hope the prince will allow me to go!"

The second prince felt that he understood what he heard. He opened his eyes wide and said, "Oh, I understand. You just look down on me! Do you think I am not as talented as my elder brother and am not worthy of being the crown prince of this country?"

Although Zheng is usually gentle and modest, now that she has spoken about this, she is not afraid of offending the second prince: "The prince is excellent in all aspects of literature, military skills, and has conquered the eighteen states in the north. He has made outstanding achievements. He also took the lead in implementing the New Deal and eradicating the bad habits of the Wei Dynasty. But such a strong-armed person was attacked by the ministers in front of him like a huge wave.I want to ask, what are your achievements and prestige, sitting in such a high position?Do the courtiers really think that you are amazingly talented, or do they think you are better than the prince? When you say it today, I don’t feel happy at all.I just feel that if you really follow the wishes of those courtiers, the road ahead will be bloody, and you will be in trouble..."

By the end of the sentence, Mrs. Zheng choked up and her pink cheeks were wet with tears.

When they were newlywed, their love was getting stronger.It was only after Han Xiao got married that he gradually realized what a clumsy person his wife was. She was not only proficient in engraving and engraving seals, but also had profound attainments in poetry, song, and dance.

It's no wonder that the Zheng family's grandfather looked down on the sour poems he wrote. Compared with this truly talented woman, he was as shallow as a naive child.

And now, Zheng's tearful words could be regarded as waking him up from his sweet dream.

He is currently learning how to handle political affairs from his royal brother, and has also listened to several verbal battles between senior ministers and his father in the court.Every time he saw his father being so angry at his old ministers, but trying to suppress his anger with all his might, he felt that being an emperor was really boring.

In the past, Han Xiao lived behind his father and brother, living leisurely. After learning how to handle documents, he could go back to the palace to carve seals and feed the fish cage birds. His life was so comfortable!

But once he becomes the prince, he has to fight wits and courage with a group of veterans who look like wolves and foxes just like his father and brother.

Although he thinks he is talented and knowledgeable, he really can't handle the mundane government affairs!

Thinking of this, most of his joy in hearing about the change of prince from his mother disappeared immediately.

Confused and panicked, Han Xiao couldn't help but ask Zheng: "But if the emperor doesn't want to be the prince, it will be me, and the father has no other sons. They insist on roasting me on the fire pit, so what should I do?"

Seeing that the second prince could still listen to her words, Mrs. Zheng softened her tone a little, stood up, whispered in the second prince's ear, and spoke in detail...

In the past few days, almost every time His Majesty saw the prince, he felt a little resentful and always scolded him.

In addition, there were refugees causing trouble in Yan County in the past few days, and there were armed fights over land, so Han Linfeng personally took people there to check the situation.

It can be regarded as an excuse to avoid his father's scolding and avoid leaving the capital.

After Han Linfeng left Beijing, the atmosphere in the court began to become strange.

On this day, the ministers were earnestly admonishing. Once again, someone pointed out Han Linfeng's bloodline and origin. He bluntly said that compared with the eldest prince, the second prince, the legitimate son, was actually a suitable candidate.

His Majesty listened silently and turned to look at his second prince.

After all, the ministers spoke in the same tone today, and it was definitely not a spur-of-the-moment idea. It was as if they had prepared the words in advance, but they didn't know how his second son would react.

If he was not persuaded by Zheng, then Han Xiao would probably listen respectfully. If his father was persuaded by the ministers, then he could only follow the trend.
